prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Nihonium (Nh) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one square 1:1 image, 1024×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a rooftop at dawn in her element's kingdom — a camera tripod, the sea and the city below and the sun just clearing the horizon
Weather / season: autumn — falling leaves and warm low light outside.
Time of day: early morning — low clean light, long soft shadows; fresh low sunlight, long cool shadows.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: a photographer look fitted to her body — a cropped hoodie over a sports bra, high-waisted shorts and trail sneakers, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera low, near the ground — level with her face when she sits, kneels or lies on the floor or a bed, looking up at her when she stands.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she holds a mirrorless camera in both hands in front of her — her own right hand holds one side, her own left hand holds the other side.
LEGS: weight even on both legs.
EXPRESSION: softened eyes, faint sad smile, inner brows raised.
Scene note: she is the sunrise photographer catching the first rays on her camera

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — nihonium: a synthetic superheavy element, the first ever discovered and named in the far east of the world, named for the land of the rising sun; a team at an eastern research institute fired zinc ions at a bismuth target day and night for nine years, from 2004 to 2012, and caught only three atoms in all; a century earlier a chemist from the same land had announced a new element under a similar name that was struck from the tables, and what he had really found turned out to be another element, so the name came back after a hundred years; it sits below thallium and is predicted to be a heavy, soft metal, but its atoms last only seconds — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
